history: R2 metrics and service budget formulated after R1 outcomes were known
normal_cost: best robust natural RMSE + max(2%,0.05m), all controls included in unqualified tables
extended_rule: evaluate every method on same full expected grid; retain missing/partial status; no successful intersection
t_return: first actually present sensor observation after deletion end
t_admit: first accepted KF update after t_return; right censor at fixed 180s observation window
bias_risk: injected-row acceptance is a stress risk proxy, never field wrong-GNSS probability
latency_clock: primary: measurement_sow of accepted update; separately report available_sow conservative bound; neither is measured wall-clock arrival
deadline_boundary_rule: inclusive on measurement-clock latency, 1e-8s tolerance; availability-bound eligibility reported separately
event_aggregation: equal-weight per-event RMSE macro; no successful-only removal
clock_alias: P_time_only at good_duration_s=2 is exactly Clock2
hypothesis_gate: H2 requires risk reduction and error reduction versus every fast normal-cost-qualified baseline; H3 requires independent new route and attribution
reference_role: time/schema only and unique first initialization row before freeze, remaining states offline only after exact remote freeze receipt
unsupported_event_rule: block complete primary matrix; do not advance/reselect by method error
coverage_gate: complete expected whole route and all five windows; no successful intersection
scientific_effect_requirement: P clean <=15s all three, natural cap and full coverage; bias90 materially below every qualified fixed strong control plus fixed event/ablation attribution; no universal/novelty inference
event_support: all 21 fixed events validated from time support before precision
measurement_maximum: whole horizontal max and every full window max are descriptive extras; primary unchanged
time_basis: independently audited bag custom GPS week and raw-text SOW; no assumed week
external_performance_scope: official public dataset literature may contain route tables; no local method performance or tuning before full freeze
figure_selection: building01 loss30_bias10 first fixed event; NIS30/B6/Clock10/Clock90/P predetermined, all fixed points retained
